# heytownhall_member (Resource)

The role of a person who is already a member of the organisation.

This resource does not add people: a person joins by accepting an invitation (see `heytownhall_invitation`). Creating the resource adopts the member and sets the role. Destroying it removes the person from the organisation.

A management token can never create, promote, demote or remove an owner. Owners are managed in the dashboard only. Pointing this resource at an owner fails with the API's `owner_protected` error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The user id of a person who has already accepted an invitation.
data "heytownhall_members" "all" {}

locals {
  user_id_by_email = { for m in data.heytownhall_members.all.members : m.email => m.user_id }
}

resource "heytownhall_member" "ana" {
  user_id = local.user_id_by_email["ana@example.com"]
  role    = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) The member's role. Only `member` can be set through the API.
- `user_id` (String) The user id of an existing member. Look it up by email with the `heytownhall_members` data source. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The member's email address.
- `id` (String) The member's user id. Same as `user_id`.
- `joined_at` (String) When the person joined (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) The member's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the member's user id.
terraform import heytownhall_member.ana 5b0a9b0e-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
